title: Anonymize real personal data before org move

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Plan: worktree /Users/example/Projects/BotSpy-anonymize on branch cursor/anonymize-personal-data-9bed off origin/develop. Phase 1: replace all real personal data in tracked files (board, docs, README, features, tests, fixtures, src comments, diagrams re-rendered via scripts/render-diagrams.sh, repo URLs generic except Cargo.toml repository field listed for move-time). Phase 2 (approved by the maintainer): git-filter-repo history rewrite with --replace-text, full mirror backup first, force-push all branches/tags excluding refs/pull/*. Guard test added in phase 1.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Milestone: board data anonymized and pushed to develop as 523fb00 (884 project files: author/comment_author/actor_id, emails, paths, session ids, org/repo names). Non-board anonymization (docs, README, features, src/spec, guard test tests/no_real_personal_data.rs, untracked llm_usage.jsonl + .gitignore) is up as PR #12 into develop; all local checks green (fmt, clippy, 64 lib + 8 BDD + fixtures + guard + spec-coverage tests), CI running. Phase 2 (history rewrite + force-push) starts after PR #12 merges and the develop→main promotion finishes.
